title: Clarify an Event Message

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Write your own first draft; the fictional example is for study, not your submission.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a colleague or friend to clarify a fictional event plan. Explain what was unclear, give the correct day and time, make one polite request, and suggest a way to prevent further confusion. Use at least six lesson words and two indirect questions.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Use four parts: the unclear message; the confirmed details; polite questions or requests; a friendly closing and reminder. Use statement order after whether or a question word.

reference: Hello Ben, thank you for your message about the community conversation. I think our first exchange caused some confusion because we mentioned the day but not the time. The event is on Thursday at five in the afternoon. Could you tell me whether the small room is available then? Could you also tell me which door the guests should use? If the room is not free, please suggest another choice and explain the reason. I apologize for leaving out the time earlier. Before we send the final message, we can discuss the wording and repeat the important details together. I will remind the manager on Wednesday and send you her response. I appreciate your help and hope the plan is clear now.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
